# Lonely Beach Restaurant, Koh Rong, Cambodia

> Lonely Beach Restaurant is a beachfront restaurant on the quiet northern coast of Koh Rong island, Cambodia. There is no road: visitors arrive by boat or by the jungle track from the pagoda at Preaek Svay.

Key facts
- Getting there from the pagoda at Preaek Svay: turn left onto the dirt road (pagoda on your right), follow the power line straight on. About 10 minutes by moto or 45 minutes on foot. From the river bridge: about 7 minutes by moto or 30 minutes on foot.
- Official parking with a donation box for the farmer; walking the last stretch is recommended. Leave the moto before the stream.
- Food: sandwiches, salads and Khmer dishes, with vegetarian and vegan options. Cocktails $4, black coffee $1.25, fresh coconut $2.00 (prices can change).
- Booking: form on the website sends a WhatsApp message. Walk-ins welcome.
- Rooms: check dates and live prices through the Stay section, which links to our Booking.com page (https://www.booking.com/hotel/kh/lonely-beach.html).
- Good to know: no wifi (a Smart SIM is the best option); electricity is fully solar, charge phones during the day; bucket showers; cash preferred, no ATMs on the island; 8 friendly dogs on site; day visitors welcome for lunch; glowing plankton best seen at night.
- Boats: the tourism pier runs boats to Long Set and Koh Touch throughout the day, last boats around 4pm.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lonelybeachkohrong/
